_comment: 由 sync_translation.py 维护，请勿手改。记录上次确认时每个已翻译键的英文原文。

json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.+ may sink in / 0 just touching / - stop: + may sink in / 0 just touching / - stops before the skin. Untick a row to stop guarding that part (hands, elbows and forearms).
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.A hand deeper than this in breasts, butt: A hand deeper than this in breasts, butt, belly or thighs is left as animated. Bony areas are always guarded.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Actors in this scene differ in size by %: Actors in this scene differ in size by %.0f%%: hands may float. See 'Actors of different size' above.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Changes apply at once and are saved auto: Changes apply at once and are saved automatically.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Experimental, off by default. The player: Experimental, off by default. The player's hands and arms stay out of their own body outside scenes too. Pauses with weapons drawn, in first person and during SexLab/OStim scenes.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Head: Head
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.How far a hand may step back toward the: How far a hand may step back toward the chest when an elbow can't get out. 0 = never.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.In SexLab and OStim scenes, each actor's: In SexLab and OStim scenes, each actor's hands and arms stay out of their own body.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Moves hands to where the animation meant: Moves hands to where the animation meant them. SexLab's Even Actors Height is the better fix when you can use it.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Not ready: OStim Standalone is installed: Not ready: OStim Standalone is installed but could not be connected. Update it to 7.5.1c or newer.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Not ready: neither SexLab nor OStim was: Not ready: neither SexLab nor OStim was found.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Not ready: the frame hook could not be i: Not ready: the frame hook could not be installed. Please check the log.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Numbers mean the same as for hands. Elbo: Numbers mean the same as for hands. Elbows and forearms share them. Unticking here turns off only the elbow and forearm.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Scenes: sleeping (waiting for a SexLab/O: Scenes: sleeping (waiting for a SexLab/OStim scene)
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Scenes: switched off ('Mod enabled' abov: Scenes: switched off ('Mod enabled' above, or the on/off key)
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Switched off for this session after an e: Switched off for this session after an error. Please check the log.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Switches the whole mod on and off during: Switches the whole mod on and off during a scene, to see what it does.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.The giver's (male) hands and arms stay o: The giver's (male) hands and arms stay out of the partner's body.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.The receiver's hands and arms stay out o: The receiver's hands and arms stay out of the partner's body.
json:menu_translation/hand-guard:SKSE/Pl.Time used by this mod: avg %.2f ms, max: Time used by this mod: avg %.2f ms, max %.2f ms (last 0.25 s)
